gcp_api_keys_active_services_only.summary: Add explicit API restrictions to the active Google Cloud API key.
steps: Identify the key by its resource name and ask the application owner which Google APIs the key actually needs.
In APIs & Services > Credentials, set API restrictions to those specific services and review client restrictions separately.
Read back the key metadata and verify restrictions.apiTargets lists the intended services; test the application with the owner before retiring any previous access.
caveats: Changing restrictions can interrupt callers that use APIs outside the approved list; review usage first.
This check establishes the presence of API targets, not whether the listed services are approved or whether client restrictions are set.
Deleted keys are not applicable; denied or malformed restriction facts remain UNKNOWN.
